text:
Iris (Prod Marketing): Need a compact launch mini-kit for next week's webinar focused on inference economics. Deliverables: hero benchmark card (web + print), 2 slide templates (data + routing), 3 social tiles (A/B copy), and a sticker-sheet of icons for SDRs. Due: Wed EOD.
Jon (Design): Got it. File formats? sizes? print specs?
Iris (Prod Marketing): Hero web 1400x770 PNG + SVG, print card 4x6 PDF (bleed), slides 16:9 Figma templates, socials 1200x1200 + 1080x1920 story. Sticker-sheet: PDF vector sheet with exportable SVG icons.
Pri (Creative Ops): Checklist: hero, slides, socials x3, sticker-sheet, Figma kit with component tokens, and a brand compliance note for Legal. Timeline: comps Mon AM, review Tue, final Wed. OK?
Sam (Growth): Data to surface: p50 latency @common seq, tokens/sec at typical batch, cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and cache improvement. Use only the internal evals link I posted. No invented stats.
Iris (Prod Marketing): Eval link: https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/inference-launch-2026 (internal). Tag rows you cite.
Jon (Design): Will provide a high-contrast accessible colorway and a muted footnote area for sources. Any imagery constraints?
LegalBot: Any quantified claim needs a small-type source line with the eval link and test date. Avoid absolute superlatives and competitor references. If you state a percent, cite the row.
Pri (Creative Ops): HubSpot routing snippet for the sticker-sheet and one-pager notes (paste into Figma):
```
utm_source=serving_launch
utm_medium=sticker_sheet
webinar_slug=serving-wins-apr
```
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/k123serving/launch-mini-kit  comment access enabled.
Jon (Design): Quick UX question: for the routing slide do you want an arrow flow or swimlanes?
Sam (Growth): Arrow flow with a tiny conditional: "if score > 70 -> SDR fast-track" (placeholder). Label steps: register -> nurture -> demo-booking.
Iris (Prod Marketing): CTA text: primary "Register" secondary "Request a demo". Keep copy engineer-forward. Hero headline: "Cut inference cost, keep latency tight."
Jon (Design): Animation? simple sparkline draw for web hero? Prototype or static?
Iris (Prod Marketing): Static first. If time, prototype the sparkline.
Pri (Creative Ops): Asana task created and I'll route legal review.
AsanaBot: Task MARKETING-3305 created: "Serving launch mini-kit" assigned to @Jon due 2026-03-30.
Jon (Design): Pushing initial frames to Figma now. Will tag when ready for review. :rocket:
Iris (Prod Marketing): Thanks team  please confirm when you upload final assets so I can prep the landing page and SDR packets.
Pri (Creative Ops): :thumbsup:
